segments.normalizedSource: ```swift private static let font1 = Font.system(size: 20) private static let font2 = Font.system(size: 45) @State private var color = Color.red @State private var currentFont = font1 var body: some View { VStack { Text("Content transition") .foregroundColor(color) .font(currentFont) .contentTransition(.interpolate) Spacer() Button("Change") { withAnimation(Animation.easeInOut(duration: 5.0)) { color = (color == .red) ? .green : .red currentFont = (currentFont == font1) ? font2 : font1 } } } } ```
